create_jsonl_reader: create a JsonlReader instance to read JSONL files from a data folder with orjson parsing
read_jsonl_file: read a JSONL file and yield each line as a separate Document with text and id keys
configure_jsonl_compression: configure JsonlReader to read gzip or zstd compressed JSONL files
adapt_jsonl_documents: provide a custom adapter function to transform JSONL data dicts into Document objects
filter_jsonl_documents: limit or skip JSONL documents and filter by glob pattern when reading from a data folder
